title: Tuesday HIIT + abs
subtitle: ~45 min · at home · follow Madeline Raskin
feeling: No thinking today. Press play, follow along, sweat, and start the day feeling good.
note: Your period is close, so listen to your body. If your uterus starts to flare up, step the jumps out or stop and rest. That still counts. Eat a real breakfast when you're done.

items.name: Small snack + water
items.cue: Half a banana or a few spoons of Greek yogurt with honey, plus a big glass of water.

items.name: Madeline Raskin HIIT or cardio intervals
items.cue: Go for it. Step the jumps out or take a break whenever you need.

items.name: Madeline Raskin abs
items.cue: Do planks on your hands, not your forearms.

items.name: Hamstring, hip and quad stretch
items.cue: About 30 sec per stretch, per side. Go easy on the hamstrings. Then breakfast!
